remarks: Ideally located just off Greenwich Avenue, this spacious two-bedroom, two-bath residence is set in a classic 1930s luxury doorman building with an elevator. This condo features large, light-filled rooms, hardwood floors throughout, oversized windows, a fireplace, and a flexible floor plan that easily accommodates today's lifestyle. Freshly painted and new windows throughout, this home is move-in ready. An assigned garage parking space and in-unit laundry--highly desirable features in downtown Greenwich--adds exceptional convenience. Just moments from Greenwich's shops, restaurants, parks, and Metro-North train station, this home offers the best of downtown Greenwich living.
